criteria.rationale: Repository configuration only: a rule-scoped gitleaks allowlist, an untracked cache file, a refreshed action-runtime record and a deeper checkout for the governance job; no CLI or artifact format changes.
The spec records the causal chain from commit to failing gate, each fix, and how its follow-ups were dispositioned, including the alerting gap now delivered by pose-red-signals-reach-a-person.
Releases v6.0.0 to v6.2.0 and v7.0.0 published through the repaired pipeline. Full native run at the sealed head with the candidate CLI built from it: 131 of 131 steps pass.

The two blockers named in the requirements; publication proof is the spawned recovery spec and alerting the spawned red-signals spec. Reviewed in the same session that implemented it, with no separate reviewer execution: declared, not independent.
The gitleaks exception is rule-scoped with condition and over path and match shape, so it cannot hide another secret; the full history scan reports no leaks.
